items.t: The first time a Projectile or beam that can Split collides with a target, it splits into a multiple which will all aim at different targets within 6 metres if able.
items.d: The first time a Projectile or beam that can Split collides with a target, it splits into a multiple which will all aim at different targets within 6 metres if able. If there aren't enough targets, the rest will be aimed in random directions.

items.t: Unarmed Damage refers to the Hit Damage of Unarmed Attacks.
items.d: Unarmed Damage refers to the Hit Damage of Unarmed Attacks. As such, Unarmed Damage is always Attack Hit Damage. Players' base Unarmed Damage is Physical, and has a minimum roll of 2, and a maximum roll between 5 - 8, depending on how aligned their class is with Strength. Other Damage is not considered Unarmed Damage, even if you are Unarmed while dealing it.

items.t: Herald Skills are a type of Persistent Buff that grant powerful effects on killing enemies.
items.d: Herald Skills are a type of Persistent Buff that grant powerful effects on killing enemies.

items.t: Overkill damage is any damage from a Hit in excess of the enemy's remaining Life when it is killed.
items.d: Overkill damage is any damage from a Hit in excess of the enemy's remaining Life when it is killed.

items.t: Frozen enemies Shatter when killed, destroying their corpse.
items.d: Frozen enemies Shatter when killed, destroying their corpse.

items.t: Withering Ground applies Withered every second to enemies standing in it.
items.d: Withering Ground applies Withered every second to enemies standing in it.

items.t: This effect does not stack.
items.d: This effect does not stack. Applying it again before the first expires will refresh the duration.

items.t: A Verisium Infusion can be used instead of any of the Elemental Infusions.
items.d: A Verisium Infusion can be used instead of any of the Elemental Infusions. Skills will prioritise using non-Verisium Infusions. Verisium Infusions last for 20 seconds or until Consumed by another Skill. Your maximum number of Verisium Infusions is equal to the maximum number of any single type of Elemental Infusion you can have (3 by default).

items.t: Fragments of Divinity are Consumed by certain Skills to grant additional effects.
items.d: Fragments of Divinity are Consumed by certain Skills to grant additional effects. Divine Fragments last 10 seconds.

items.t: Onslaught grants 20% increased Skill Speed and 10% increased movement speed.
items.d: Onslaught grants 20% increased Skill Speed and 10% increased movement speed. Unless specified, Onslaught lasts 4 seconds.

items.t: When you deal damage with a Hit, Life Leech causes you to recover an amount of Life to a percentage of the damage dealt, over a period of one second.
items.d: When you deal damage with a Hit, Life Leech causes you to recover an amount of Life to a percentage of the damage dealt, over a period of one second. Hits that deal more than 40,000 total damage are treated as though they only dealt 40,000 damage for this calculation. If this damage is of multiple Damage Types, the ratios between them will stay the same. Monsters have Leech Resistance that increases with monster level, reducing how much you recover from Leech from Hits against them. You can only recover from a single instance of Life Leech at a time, and all Life Leech is removed when Life is filled.

items.t: A Temporary Minion is a Minion that does not revive after it dies.
items.d: A Temporary Minion is a Minion that does not revive after it dies.

items.t: Sundered Armour is a Debuff that can be applied to enemies with Fully Broken Armour that increases the Physical damage they take from Hits by an additional 20%.
items.d: Sundered Armour is a Debuff that can be applied to enemies with Fully Broken Armour that increases the Physical damage they take from Hits by an additional 20%. This effect stacks with the target's normal Fully Broken Armour. Unless otherwise specified, modifiers to Fully Broken Armour also apply to Sundered Armour. Enemies with Sundered Armour cannot get their Armour Broken further.

items.t: Skills that meet this requirement use the term "Final Strike" to refer to the last strike of their sequence.
items.d: Skills that meet this requirement use the term "Final Strike" to refer to the last strike of their sequence.

items.t: DNT-UNUSED You gain edict declaration when you disable a mod with The Towering Shadow
items.d: DNT-UNUSED You gain edict declaration when you disable a mod with The Towering Shadow

items.t: Penetration causes the target's corresponding Resistance to be treated as lower than its actual value by the specified amount when of calculating Damage taken from your…
items.d: Penetration causes the target's corresponding Resistance to be treated as lower than its actual value by the specified amount when of calculating Damage taken from your Hits. Resistances can only be Penetrated down to a minimum of 0% by default. Since Penetration only affects Hits and applies to the target's defensive stats rather than your own offensive stats, it does not affect damage with Ailments.

items.t: Traps are Two-Handed ranged weapons that require Dexterity and Intelligence to equip.
items.d: Traps are Two-Handed ranged weapons that require Dexterity and Intelligence to equip. Traps cannot be used to Attack directly. Throwing a Trap places it on the ground, where it can either be detonated manually or triggered by Close by enemies depending on the Trap type.

items.t: Converting stat A to stat B applies the base value of stat A to stat B instead.
items.d: Converting stat A to stat B applies the base value of stat A to stat B instead. The converted stat scales with percentage modifiers to stat B, but not with percentage modifiers to stat A. For example, if you converted your Evasion to Armour, the converted portion would be scaled by percentage modifiers to Armour, but percentage modifiers to Evasion would have no effect.

items.t: Certain Skills which create Areas of Effect on the ground create Runic Inscriptions when doing so.
items.d: Certain Skills which create Areas of Effect on the ground create Runic Inscriptions when doing so. Various effects such as Support Gems and Unique Items can interact with these Inscriptions to cause many different effects.

items.t: This modifier applies to Debuffs you inflict that Slow enemies, and scales only the specific Magnitude that slows the target.
items.d: This modifier applies to Debuffs you inflict that Slow enemies, and scales only the specific Magnitude that slows the target. It will not affect any other Magnitudes that Debuff has if it does other things in addition to the Slow.

items.t: Wind Skills gain additional interactions with other specified Skills, typically Fire Skills.
items.d: Wind Skills gain additional interactions with other specified Skills, typically Fire Skills.

items.t: When you deal damage with a Hit, Rage Leech causes you to recover an amount of Rage to a percentage of the damage dealt, over a period of one second.
items.d: When you deal damage with a Hit, Rage Leech causes you to recover an amount of Rage to a percentage of the damage dealt, over a period of one second. Hits that deal more than 40,000 total damage are treated as though they only dealt 40,000 damage for this calculation. If this damage is of multiple Damage Types, the ratios between them will stay the same. Monsters have Leech Resistance that increases with monster level, reducing how much you recover from Leech from Hits against them. You can only recover from a single instance of Rage Leech at a time, and all Rage Leech is removed when Rage is filled.

items.t: Strike Skills can be made to deal Splash damage when hitting an enemy, causing an additional Hit to other enemies around the one hit by the Strike.
items.d: Strike Skills can be made to deal Splash damage when hitting an enemy, causing an additional Hit to other enemies around the one hit by the Strike. The base radius of Splash damage is 1.5 metres.

items.t: You are on Low Mana if you have 35% of your Maximum Mana or less.
items.d: You are on Low Mana if you have 35% of your Maximum Mana or less.

items.t: Runes are Augments of Kalguuran origin and make.
items.d: Runes are Augments of Kalguuran origin and make.

items.t: Ignite that has been Aggravated deals 100% extra damage.
items.d: Ignite that has been Aggravated deals 100% extra damage. Once an Ignite has been Aggravated, it will remain Aggravated until its duration expires. Just like Bleeding, each Ignite Debuff can be Aggravated, or not, independently of others on the target.

items.t: This effect will occur when a hit with the weapon directly causes at least one Bleeding Debuff on the target to become Aggravated.
items.d: This effect will occur when a hit with the weapon directly causes at least one Bleeding Debuff on the target to become Aggravated. It will not occur if an on-hit effect tries to Aggravate Bleeding but there are no Bleeding Debuffs on the target to Aggravate, or all of them are already Aggravated, since no Bleeding Debuffs will be Aggravated by that hit.

items.t: Freezing shards fire around you in a spiral when in range of enemies.
items.d: Freezing shards fire around you in a spiral when in range of enemies.

items.t: Meteors rain down around you when in range of enemies.
items.d: Meteors rain down around you when in range of enemies.

items.t: Lightning bolts strike the ground around you when in range of enemies.
items.d: Lightning bolts strike the ground around you when in range of enemies.

items.t: Certain items can be found Corrupted or made Corrupted using a Vaal Orb, changing their properties unpredictably.
items.d: Certain items can be found Corrupted or made Corrupted using a Vaal Orb, changing their properties unpredictably. Most methods of item crafting and modification cannot be used on Corrupted items. There is no penalty for using Corrupted items.

items.t: Shrines are Precursor Artifacts that empower monsters with its Presence with various effects.
items.d: Shrines are Precursor Artifacts that empower monsters with its Presence with various effects. Defeat all the monsters Worshipping the Shrine and interact with it to temporarily gain the power for yourself.

items.t: Explosive Fervour is a Buff that grants 15% increased Attack Speed per different Grenade Skill you've used Recently, causes Grenade Skills to ignore their cooldown and f…
items.d: Explosive Fervour is a Buff that grants 15% increased Attack Speed per different Grenade Skill you've used Recently, causes Grenade Skills to ignore their cooldown and fire an additional projectile, and makes Grenades explode on any impact. You cannot gain Explosive Rhythm while you have Explosive Fervour.

items.t: Each Explosive Rhythm Buff grants 10% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate to your Grenade Skills.
items.d: Each Explosive Rhythm Buff grants 10% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate to your Grenade Skills.

items.t: The first Gruelling Madness on a target Slows their movement speed by 15%.
items.d: The first Gruelling Madness on a target Slows their movement speed by 15%. Each additional Gruelling Madness instead increases the Slowing Potency of Debuffs on the targets by 10%, which affects both the first Gruelling Madness and any other Debuffs that are Slowing the target. A maximum of 10 Gruelling Madness can be inflicted on each target. Targets will lose 1 Gruelling Madness every 2 seconds that passes without more being inflicted.

items.t: Quivers are off hand items that are only usable while you have a Bow equipped.
items.d: Quivers are off hand items that are only usable while you have a Bow equipped. Quivers provide a variety of bonuses to Bow Attacks.

items.t: Druidic Prowess is a stacking Buff which grants 10% increased Skill Speed and causes Hits with Spell Damage to grant 3 Rage per stack for 10 seconds.
items.d: Druidic Prowess is a stacking Buff which grants 10% increased Skill Speed and causes Hits with Spell Damage to grant 3 Rage per stack for 10 seconds. Each stack has an independent duration. Maximum 3 stacks.

items.t: Targets affected by a Spectral Fire Debuff do not take damage from Ignite.
items.d: Targets affected by a Spectral Fire Debuff do not take damage from Ignite. Instead that damage feeds the Spectral Fire. When the Spectral Fire Debuff expires or the target dies, the Spectral Fire explodes, dealing all the damage it has absorbed to all enemies within 1.8m, including the affected target. Damage modifiers do not apply to the explosion.

items.t: Desecrating an item adds an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier.
items.d: Desecrating an item adds an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier. If modifiers are full then a random modifier is also removed. These modifiers can be revealed at the Well of Souls. Items with Desecrated Modifiers cannot be Desecrated again.

items.t: Puppet Master is a stacking Buff which grants: 10% increased Skill Speed with Command Skills 10% reduced Movement Speed Penalty with Command Skills Minions deal 10% incr…
items.d: Puppet Master is a stacking Buff which grants: 10% increased Skill Speed with Command Skills 10% reduced Movement Speed Penalty with Command Skills Minions deal 10% increased damage with Command Skills Minions have 2% increased Movement Speed Minions have 3% increased Skill Speed Each stack has an independent duration of 8 seconds. Maximum 5 stacks.

items.t: Curses you inflict have 4% increased Curse Magnitudes for each Dark Whisper you have.
items.d: Curses you inflict have 4% increased Curse Magnitudes for each Dark Whisper you have. You can have a maximum of 10 Dark Whispers. Dark Whispers last for 8 seconds, and this duration is refreshed whenever you gain more. When Dark Whispers expire, you Lose 3% of Life, Mana, and Energy Shield for each of them, over 4 seconds.

items.t: Hexproof means that you are Unaffected by Curses.
items.d: Hexproof means that you are Unaffected by Curses.

items.t: Items can be Normal (grey), Magic (blue), Rare (yellow) or Unique (brown).
items.d: Items can be Normal (grey), Magic (blue), Rare (yellow) or Unique (brown). Item Classes which do not have these rarities, such as Currency, have individual rarity for each item. Magic items can have 2 Modifiers; a Prefix and a Suffix. Rare items can have up to 6 Modifiers; 3 Prefixes and 3 Suffixes. More powerful and dangerous enemies are more likely to drop rarer Items.

items.t: Unlucky things are rolled twice and the worse result used.
items.d: Unlucky things are rolled twice and the worse result used.

items.t: Uncapped Resistance is the value a Resistance would have if ignoring Maximum Resistance.
items.d: Uncapped Resistance is the value a Resistance would have if ignoring Maximum Resistance. These values are shown in parentheses at the top of the Character Panel.

items.t: The maximum value of this modifier is applied to the whole modifier, including the constant part.
items.d: The maximum value of this modifier is applied to the whole modifier, including the constant part.

items.t: Raven-Touched items have been warped by the Raven Trickster, Tangmazu.
items.d: Raven-Touched items have been warped by the Raven Trickster, Tangmazu. The influence of the mist allows you to instil the item with a Notable Passive Skill at the Withered Willow. Items that are already instillable will not be able to gain an additional instillment if they become Raven-Touched.

items.t: Axes are Melee weapons that can be One-Handed or Two-Handed.
items.d: Axes are Melee weapons that can be One-Handed or Two-Handed. Axes require Strength and Dexterity to equip. Axe Attacks commonly involve throwing your axe and/or inflicting Bleeding.

items.t: Swords are Melee weapons that can be One-Handed or Two-Handed.
items.d: Swords are Melee weapons that can be One-Handed or Two-Handed. Swords require Strength and Dexterity to equip. Sword Attacks are commonly related to elemental damage.

items.t: Two-handed weapons take up both weapon slots when equipped.
items.d: Two-handed weapons take up both weapon slots when equipped.

items.t: Equipment are items that can be Equipped
items.d: Equipment are items that can be Equipped

items.t: Any mechanic where the calculation of a single Hit would roll Critical Hit Chance more than once is considered to be Rerolling.
items.d: Any mechanic where the calculation of a single Hit would roll Critical Hit Chance more than once is considered to be Rerolling. This includes anything that makes Critical Hit Chance Lucky, Unlucky, Bifurcated, or Inevitable. Sustained Skills using an independent Critical Hit Chance roll for each different time they deal damage is not Rerolling.

items.t: Crescendo Arrows Chain 6 additional times and deal 60% increased Damage for each time they have Chained.
items.d: Crescendo Arrows Chain 6 additional times and deal 60% increased Damage for each time they have Chained.

items.t: All Hits with Diamond Arrows are Critical Hits with 60% increased Critical Damage Bonus.
items.d: All Hits with Diamond Arrows are Critical Hits with 60% increased Critical Damage Bonus.

items.t: Reversing Arrows Pierce all targets and Return to you.
items.d: Reversing Arrows Pierce all targets and Return to you.

items.t: Enemies killed with Covetous Arrows drop items with 600% increased Rarity.
items.d: Enemies killed with Covetous Arrows drop items with 600% increased Rarity.

items.t: Splintering Arrows Split towards 6 targets.
items.d: Splintering Arrows Split towards 6 targets.

items.t: Blunt Arrows cause 600% increased Stun Buildup.
items.d: Blunt Arrows cause 600% increased Stun Buildup.

items.t: When you deal damage with a Hit, Energy Shield Leech causes you to recover an amount of Energy Shield to a percentage of the damage dealt, over a period of one second.
items.d: When you deal damage with a Hit, Energy Shield Leech causes you to recover an amount of Energy Shield to a percentage of the damage dealt, over a period of one second. Hits that deal more than 40,000 total damage are treated as though they only dealt 40,000 damage for this calculation. If this damage is of multiple Damage Types, the ratios between them will stay the same. Monsters have Leech Resistance that increases with monster level, reducing how much you recover from Leech from Hits against them. You can only recover from a single instance of Energy Shield Leech at a time, and all Energy Shield Leech is removed when Energy Shield is filled. Modifiers specific to Life Leech will not apply to Energy Shield Leech.

items.t: Upfront Costs will result in taking the damage all at once as a Hit.
items.d: Upfront Costs will result in taking the damage all at once as a Hit. A per-second costs will instead result in taking Damage per second, which is damage over time, and thus not a Hit.

items.t: Soul Cores are artifacts of the ancient Vaal empire and function as a type of Augment.
items.d: Soul Cores are artifacts of the ancient Vaal empire and function as a type of Augment.

items.t: Each Fear Incarnate grants 10% increased Culling Strike Threshold and lasts 10 seconds.
items.d: Each Fear Incarnate grants 10% increased Culling Strike Threshold and lasts 10 seconds. This duration is refreshed when you gain another Fear Incarnate. You can have up to a maximum of 20 Fear Incarnate.

items.t: Modifiers to the Effect of Buffs or Debuffs usually come from the target it affects and are multiplicative with modifiers to the Magnitudes of the Buff or Debuff, which…
items.d: Modifiers to the Effect of Buffs or Debuffs usually come from the target it affects and are multiplicative with modifiers to the Magnitudes of the Buff or Debuff, which come from its creator.

items.t: Each Runic Binding grants 10% reduced Spell Damage and 2% reduced Skill cost Efficiency.
items.d: Each Runic Binding grants 10% reduced Spell Damage and 2% reduced Skill cost Efficiency. You can have up to 10 Runic Bindings. Runic Bindings last for 10 seconds. Runic Bindings cannot be gained while Shapeshifted.

items.t: Each Unbound Potential grants 20% increased Damage, 10% increased Armour, and 10% increased Energy Shield.
items.d: Each Unbound Potential grants 20% increased Damage, 10% increased Armour, and 10% increased Energy Shield. You can have up to 10 Unbound Potential, and will lose one every 5 seconds. Lose all Unbound Potential when you Shapeshift into a Human.

items.t: Each "Boss Encounter" icon on the World Screen is a face which can be broken by beating the encounter.
items.d: Each "Boss Encounter" icon on the World Screen is a face which can be broken by beating the encounter. "Rare Monster Encounter" icons do not provide any bonus when broken.

items.t: Weapon, Armour, Belt, and Jewellery Items are Equipped to the character in the Inventory Panel.
items.d: Weapon, Armour, Belt, and Jewellery Items are Equipped to the character in the Inventory Panel. Flasks, Skill Gems, and Jewels are never considered to be Equipped.

items.t: Hits against Full Life Enemies remove between 5% and 30% of Life, before the damage of the Hit is applied.
items.d: Hits against Full Life Enemies remove between 5% and 30% of Life, before the damage of the Hit is applied.

items.t: Each Soul eaten grants 1% increased Skill Speed.
items.d: Each Soul eaten grants 1% increased Skill Speed. You can have up to 50 eaten Souls, and lose a Soul every 0.5 seconds if you have not eaten one in the past 4 seconds.

items.t: Revealed Weaknesses are highlighted on enemy Life bars, and occupy a total of 45% of their maximum Life (but in random segments).
items.d: Revealed Weaknesses are highlighted on enemy Life bars, and occupy a total of 45% of their maximum Life (but in random segments). While the enemy's current Life is within a highlighted segment, they are considered to have an Open Weakness.

items.t: You can have up to 10,000 Runefather's Boast Buffs.
items.d: You can have up to 10,000 Runefather's Boast Buffs. Each Runefather's Boast grants +1 to Armour, +1 to Evasion Rating, and +1 to Stun Threshold. Runefather's Boast does not have a duration, but is lost when you die or change area.

items.t: Runefather's Challenge is a Debuff which raises the Power of affected targets by 5.
items.d: Runefather's Challenge is a Debuff which raises the Power of affected targets by 5.

items.t: When you reach full Energy Shield, Sacrifice all Energy Shield to gain +5% to all Maximum Resistances for 4 seconds
items.d: When you reach full Energy Shield, Sacrifice all Energy Shield to gain +5% to all Maximum Resistances for 4 seconds

items.t: This allows your Thorns to Retaliate against any kind of Hit dealt to you by enemies, rather than just Melee Attacks, except that you can never Retaliate against the ene…
items.d: This allows your Thorns to Retaliate against any kind of Hit dealt to you by enemies, rather than just Melee Attacks, except that you can never Retaliate against the enemy's Thorns damage.

items.t: Tailwind is a stacking Buff which grants 1% increased movement speed, 2% increased Skill Speed, 10% increased Evasion Rating and prevent 1% of Damage from Deflected Hits…
items.d: Tailwind is a stacking Buff which grants 1% increased movement speed, 2% increased Skill Speed, 10% increased Evasion Rating and prevent 1% of Damage from Deflected Hits per stack. Maximum 10 stacks. Lose all Tailwind stacks when Hit.

items.n: Faster Start of Energy Shield Recharge
items.t: Affects the delay before your Energy Shield starts Recharging after losing Energy Shield.
items.d: Affects the delay before your Energy Shield starts Recharging after losing Energy Shield.

items.t: Increasing your Stun Recovery causes you to recover more quickly from being Stunned.
items.d: Increasing your Stun Recovery causes you to recover more quickly from being Stunned.

items.t: Gain no inherent bonus from Strength 1% increased Projectile Attack damage per 2 Strength
items.d: Gain no inherent bonus from Strength 1% increased Projectile Attack damage per 2 Strength

items.t: Gain no inherent bonus from Strength 1% increased Spell damage per 2 Strength
items.d: Gain no inherent bonus from Strength 1% increased Spell damage per 2 Strength

items.t: Their modifiers to the amount they leech will not affect this amount; your modifiers have already applied to it.
items.d: Their modifiers to the amount they leech will not affect this amount; your modifiers have already applied to it.

items.t: Enemies standing in Smoke Clouds are Blinded.
items.d: Enemies standing in Smoke Clouds are Blinded. Smoke Clouds have a radius of 2 metres unless otherwise specified.

items.t: Lost Life will start Recharging at a rate of 12.5% per second after a base delay of 4 seconds.
items.d: Lost Life will start Recharging at a rate of 12.5% per second after a base delay of 4 seconds. Further loss of Life resets this delay, interrupting Recharge. Modifiers to Energy Shield Recharge Rate or to how fast it starts will also apply to Life Recharge.

items.t: Legacy of Amethyst is a Mage's Legacy which grants +45% to Chaos Resistance.
items.d: Legacy of Amethyst is a Mage's Legacy which grants +45% to Chaos Resistance.

items.t: Legacy of Basalt is a Mage's Legacy which grants 150% increased Armour.
items.d: Legacy of Basalt is a Mage's Legacy which grants 150% increased Armour.

items.t: Legacy of Bismuth is a Mage's Legacy which grants +45% to all Elemental Resistances.
items.d: Legacy of Bismuth is a Mage's Legacy which grants +45% to all Elemental Resistances.

items.t: Legacy of Diamond is a Mage's Legacy which grants 75% increased Critical Hit Chance.
items.d: Legacy of Diamond is a Mage's Legacy which grants 75% increased Critical Hit Chance.

items.t: Legacy of Gold is a Mage's Legacy which grants 45% increased Rarity of Items found.
items.d: Legacy of Gold is a Mage's Legacy which grants 45% increased Rarity of Items found.

items.t: Legacy of Granite is a Mage's Legacy which grants +2000 to Armour.
items.d: Legacy of Granite is a Mage's Legacy which grants +2000 to Armour.

items.t: Legacy of Jade is a Mage's Legacy which grants +2000 to Evasion Rating.
items.d: Legacy of Jade is a Mage's Legacy which grants +2000 to Evasion Rating.

items.t: Legacy of Quicksilver is a Mage's Legacy which grants 30% increased Movement Speed.
items.d: Legacy of Quicksilver is a Mage's Legacy which grants 30% increased Movement Speed.

items.t: Legacy of Ruby is a Mage's Legacy which grants +60% to Fire Resistance and +5% to Maximum Fire Resistance.
items.d: Legacy of Ruby is a Mage's Legacy which grants +60% to Fire Resistance and +5% to Maximum Fire Resistance.

items.t: Legacy of Sapphire is a Mage's Legacy which grants +60% to Cold Resistance and +5% to Maximum Cold Resistance.
items.d: Legacy of Sapphire is a Mage's Legacy which grants +60% to Cold Resistance and +5% to Maximum Cold Resistance.

items.t: Legacy of Silver is a Mage's Legacy which grants 30% increased Skill Speed.
items.d: Legacy of Silver is a Mage's Legacy which grants 30% increased Skill Speed.

items.t: Legacy of Stibnite is a Mage's Legacy which grants 150% increased Evasion Rating.
items.d: Legacy of Stibnite is a Mage's Legacy which grants 150% increased Evasion Rating.

items.t: Legacy of Sulphur is a Mage's Legacy which grants 60% increased Damage, and makes the area within 2.5 metres of you Consecrated Ground while you're stationary.
items.d: Legacy of Sulphur is a Mage's Legacy which grants 60% increased Damage, and makes the area within 2.5 metres of you Consecrated Ground while you're stationary.

items.t: Legacy of Topaz is a Mage's Legacy which grants +60% to Lightning Resistance and +5% to Maximum Lightning Resistance.
items.d: Legacy of Topaz is a Mage's Legacy which grants +60% to Lightning Resistance and +5% to Maximum Lightning Resistance.

items.t: There are a number of possible Mage's Legacies, each granting a different bonus: • Legacy of Amethyst • Legacy of Basalt • Legacy of Bismuth • Legacy of Diamond • Legacy…
items.d: There are a number of possible Mage's Legacies, each granting a different bonus: • Legacy of Amethyst • Legacy of Basalt • Legacy of Bismuth • Legacy of Diamond • Legacy of Gold • Legacy of Granite • Legacy of Jade • Legacy of Quicksilver • Legacy of Ruby • Legacy of Sapphire • Legacy of Silver • Legacy of Stibnite • Legacy of Sulphur • Legacy of Topaz Only one instance of each Mage's Legacy can apply its bonus to you at a time.

items.t: Ignoring Resistances means your damage cannot be modified in any way by the target's Resistance stats.
items.d: Ignoring Resistances means your damage cannot be modified in any way by the target's Resistance stats.

items.t: Augments are items which can be placed into Augment sockets, usually on Equipment items.
items.d: Augments are items which can be placed into Augment sockets, usually on Equipment items. Once socketed, they can be replaced by other Augments, but cannot be removed by normal means. The types of Equipment which an Augment can be placed into and the corresponding benefit provided are listed on the item.

items.t: Divinity can be spent for skills, similar to Mana.
items.d: Divinity can be spent for skills, similar to Mana. Divinity inherently Regenerates at a rate of 25% per second.

items.t: Liquid Emotions are Currency items that are exclusive drops from the Delirium mechanic.
items.d: Liquid Emotions are Currency items that are exclusive drops from the Delirium mechanic. Liquid Emotions allow you to instil an amulet with a Notable Passive Skill from the Passive Tree. Instilling a Notable Passive Skill which you have already allocated normally will not grant its effects a second time.

items.t: Abyssal Wasting reduces Life Regeneration Rate by 50% for 6 seconds
items.d: Abyssal Wasting reduces Life Regeneration Rate by 50% for 6 seconds

items.t: Debilitate is a Debuff that inflicts 20% reduced movement speed and 10% reduced damage dealt.
items.d: Debilitate is a Debuff that inflicts 20% reduced movement speed and 10% reduced damage dealt. Unless specified, Debilitate lasts 1 second.

items.t: Foci are armour items that are equipped in your off hand and require Intelligence to equip.
items.d: Foci are armour items that are equipped in your off hand and require Intelligence to equip. Foci can grant significant amounts of Energy Shield and powerful bonuses to your Spells.

items.t: Jewels are items that can be socketed into Jewel Sockets on the Passive Skill Tree to grant bonuses.
items.d: Jewels are items that can be socketed into Jewel Sockets on the Passive Skill Tree to grant bonuses. Basic Jewels simply grant you the listed stats, while some other kinds of Jewel can have more complicated effects, such as modifying other Passive Skills within a certain radius.

items.t: Allocated Sinister Jewel Sockets are visible on the left edge of the character portrait in the centre of the passive skill tree.
items.d: Allocated Sinister Jewel Sockets are visible on the left edge of the character portrait in the centre of the passive skill tree. Unique Jewels cannot be socketed in Sinister Jewel Sockets, and modifiers to the effect of Jewel Sockets do not apply to Sinister Jewel Sockets. They are entirely disconnected from the rest of your passive skill tree - they are not considered to be within any radius of any other passive skill, and no passive skill is within any radius of a Sinister Jewel Socket. Multiple Sinister Jewel Sockets are also not within any radius of each other. Radius effects of Jewels will therefore have no effect when socketed in Sinister Sockets.

items.t: Small Passive Skills are Passives that are not Notables, Keystones, Ascendancy Passive Skills or Passive Skills where you can select an Attribute.
items.d: Small Passive Skills are Passives that are not Notables, Keystones, Ascendancy Passive Skills or Passive Skills where you can select an Attribute.

items.t: You can only have one Historic Jewel socketed.
items.d: You can only have one Historic Jewel socketed.

items.t: This item can be Desecrated using the Preserved Cranium currency item.
items.d: This item can be Desecrated using the Preserved Cranium currency item. There is an increasing chance for it to be destroyed each time it is Desecrated.

items.t: Players possessed by Spirits of the Azmeri gain powerful buffs depending on what Spirit Animal has possessed them.
items.d: Players possessed by Spirits of the Azmeri gain powerful buffs depending on what Spirit Animal has possessed them. Spiritual beasts will occasionally be summoned to aid the player. Players can only be possessed by one Spirit at a time.

items.t: Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Boar Gain 20% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage, always inflict Bleeding on Hit and have 20% reduced damage taken.
items.d: Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Boar Gain 20% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage, always inflict Bleeding on Hit and have 20% reduced damage taken. Players will also periodically summon spiritual Boars that explode, dealing Fire Damage.

items.t: Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Cat have 60% increased Evasion Rating, 100% increased Critical Hit chance, 30% increased Skill Speed and 15% increased Movement Sp…
items.d: Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Cat have 60% increased Evasion Rating, 100% increased Critical Hit chance, 30% increased Skill Speed and 15% increased Movement Speed. Players will also periodically summon a ravaging flurry of spiritual Cats.

items.t: Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Primate have All Damage from Hits Contributes to Chill Magnitude, 60% Increased Freeze Buildup and 80% increased Damage.
items.d: Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Primate have All Damage from Hits Contributes to Chill Magnitude, 60% Increased Freeze Buildup and 80% increased Damage. Players will also periodically summon a group of spiritual Primates.

items.t: Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Serpent have All Damage from Hits Contributes to Poison Magnitude, Always Poison on Hit and 80% increased Damage.
items.d: Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Serpent have All Damage from Hits Contributes to Poison Magnitude, Always Poison on Hit and 80% increased Damage. Players will also be accompanied by Spiritual Snakes that periodically strike enemies.

items.t: Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Stag have +30% to all Elemental Resistances, 30% increased Skill Speed, 15% increased Movement Speed and Gain 20% of Damage as Ext…
items.d: Players possessed by the Spirit Of The Stag have +30% to all Elemental Resistances, 30% increased Skill Speed, 15% increased Movement Speed and Gain 20% of Damage as Extra Lightning Damage. Players will also periodically summon a spiritual Stag that calls down Lightning bolts.

items.t: Absorption effects include Guard, Encased in Jade and Sorcery Ward.
items.d: Absorption effects include Guard, Encased in Jade and Sorcery Ward.

items.t: Honour is an additional resource you have to manage within the Trial of the Sekhemas.
items.d: Honour is an additional resource you have to manage within the Trial of the Sekhemas. A percentage of the damage you take from enemies in the Trial will be taken from your Honour. If your Honour reaches zero then the Trial is failed. Your starting and maximum Honour are the sum of your maximum Life, Energy Shield and Runic Ward. Your maximum Mana is also added if you have Mind Over Matter.

items.t: Area has +1 to Monster Level.
items.d: Area has +1 to Monster Level.

items.t: Precursor Towers are ancient structures that are scattered all throughout the Atlas.
items.d: Precursor Towers are ancient structures that are scattered all throughout the Atlas. Precursor Tower Maps can be completed to reveal a large area around them and to obtain a Tablet. Completing a Precursor Tower requires you to activate the Precursor Beacon at the end of the Map, after defeating the Map Boss.

items.t: Irradiated Areas have +1 to Monster Level
items.d: Irradiated Areas have +1 to Monster Level

items.t: Ritual Altars are sacrificial sites that absorb the monsters slain within their ritual circles.
items.d: Ritual Altars are sacrificial sites that absorb the monsters slain within their ritual circles. After an amount of monsters have been slain, the Ritual can be activated. Activating the Ritual will resurrect the slain monsters, requiring you slay them once more. Defeating these revived monsters earns you Tribute, a resource that you can trade for various Favours from the Ritual Altar. The list of Favours tradable for Tribute can be rerolled, costing Tribute. Favours can be deferred, paying a part of their cost but having them appear again later.

items.t: An Abyss is a pit which leads deep underground with multiple fissures branching from it.
items.d: An Abyss is a pit which leads deep underground with multiple fissures branching from it. Any monsters spawned near an Abyss will be weakened by it. Defeating these weakened monsters will cause the fissures to close. Once the fissures have closed all the way to the pit, the pit will activate and spawn a large number of Abyssal monsters. Defeating these monsters will close the pit. Each closed pit has a chance to spawn an Abyssal Trove which can grant pieces of Preserved Bone to craft onto your Items. The final Abyss in the area has a chance to instead open an underground dungeon called an Abyssal Depths. There are three separate groups of Abyssal Monsters: the Lightless, the Blackblooded and the Legion of the Pit, each area generally contains one of these groups. The rarity of the monsters spawned depends on the rarity of the slain weakened monsters and the emerging Abyssal will steal some or all of the modifiers from them. Any of the modifiers stolen by Rare Abyssal can be upgraded to Abyssal Modifiers.

items.t: Biomes are found throughout Endgame Maps.
items.d: Biomes are found throughout Endgame Maps. Grass, Forest, Swamp, Desert, Mountain and Water Biomes are all commonly found. Cities and special biomes are less likely to be encountered.

items.t: Azmeri Spirits are the spirits of various Azmeri Animal Guardians.
items.d: Azmeri Spirits are the spirits of various Azmeri Animal Guardians. Azmeri Spirits appear as wisps that flee as you approach them. Normal or Magic Monsters the Spirit comes into contact with become Spirit-Influenced, while Rare or Unique monsters will be Possessed. Spirit-Influenced or Possessed monsters are stronger and more rewarding. Possession's bonuses are more effective for each monster the Spirit has Influenced.

items.t: Empowering a Map Boss upgrades it to a Powerful Map Boss
items.d: Empowering a Map Boss upgrades it to a Powerful Map Boss

items.t: Endgame Maps each contain a Map Boss.
items.d: Endgame Maps each contain a Map Boss. These Map Bosses are Unique Monsters that have special mechanics and drop increased rewards. Defeating the Map Boss will complete the Map.

items.t: Breaches allow invaders from another world to access ours.
items.d: Breaches allow invaders from another world to access ours. Unstable Breaches are a small tear in the fabric that will open for a short time. Kill Breach monsters to keep them open longer. Once enough monsters have been killed, the Breach will stabalise, calling stronger monsters through the portal at the centre. Kill these monsters in the centre will complete the Unstable Breach, closing the tear. A Breach Hive is a tear that has already grown out of control. You will need the help of Ailith to close these. With a blessing from Chayula, burn your way to the centre of the Hive and help Ailith start the process of destorying the centre. As Ailith destroys the Hive, Breach monsters will pour in to try and kill her. Defend Ailith until she has completely destroyed the centre of the hive to remove it from existence. If Ailith dies during this, the Hive will remain.

items.t: Maps containing a Delirium Mirror can have the mirror walked through to unleash the rolling Delirium fog ring across the current area.
items.d: Maps containing a Delirium Mirror can have the mirror walked through to unleash the rolling Delirium fog ring across the current area. You must stay within this fog as it expands to maintain the Delirium or it will disappear. Magic monsters are able to gain Delirium specific Modifiers while inside the fog. Rare or Unique monsters in the fog may manifest Delirium Demons. Manifested Delirium Demons inhabit the monster's body to occasionally use Skills of their own. Fractured Mirrors may be found within Delirium Fog, summoning extra monsters while Fracturing Mirror Shards are found at set depths, with more varied rewards. Defeating Map Bosses has a chance to summon a Grand Mirror on a nearby map.

items.t: Delirious players are assaulted by illusions, making combat more difficult.
items.d: Delirious players are assaulted by illusions, making combat more difficult. Higher delirium causes monsters to deal more damage and have additional Toughness. It can also cause additional monsters to appear or can grant additional modifiers to existing monsters. Monster item drops are improved by higher delirium. Maps within Fog Banks gain Deliriousness as Map Bosses, Rare Monsters or Unique Monsters are killed.

items.t: Close Range is anywhere within 2 metres of your character.
items.d: Close Range is anywhere within 2 metres of your character. Normally, Melee Attacks you make are in Close Range.

items.t: Ailments that do not deal damage are Chill, Freeze, Shock, and Electrocute.
items.d: Ailments that do not deal damage are Chill, Freeze, Shock, and Electrocute.

items.t: Daggers are One-Handed Melee weapons that require Dexterity and Intelligence to equip.
items.d: Daggers are One-Handed Melee weapons that require Dexterity and Intelligence to equip. Dagger Attacks are commonly related to ambushing or debilitating enemies. Some blade-related Spells also require a Dagger.

items.t: Flails are One-Handed Melee weapons that require Strength and Intelligence to equip.
items.d: Flails are One-Handed Melee weapons that require Strength and Intelligence to equip. Flails cannot be Dual Wielded. Flail Attacks tend to reward careful placement and long wind-up times with devastating effects.

items.t: An Ancestrally Boosted Spell has 30% more damage and 25% increased area of effect.
items.d: An Ancestrally Boosted Spell has 30% more damage and 25% increased area of effect. Triggered Skills cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

items.t: Enemies have less Cooldown Recovery Rate the lower their Concentration, scaling down to 50% less Cooldown Recovery Rate when Concentration is 0%.
items.d: Enemies have less Cooldown Recovery Rate the lower their Concentration, scaling down to 50% less Cooldown Recovery Rate when Concentration is 0%.

items.t: Freeze Threshold determines how much Freeze buildup is needed to Freeze a target.
items.d: Freeze Threshold determines how much Freeze buildup is needed to Freeze a target.

items.t: Totems you place which grant Embankment Auras give a different Aura Buff to Players in range depending on the kind of Totem, as follows: Artillery Ballista grants 20% in…
items.d: Totems you place which grant Embankment Auras give a different Aura Buff to Players in range depending on the kind of Totem, as follows: Artillery Ballista grants 20% increased Skill Speed. Siege Ballista grants 25% more Damage against Immobilised Enemies. Mortar Cannon grants 25% of Damage Gained as extra Fire. Shockwave Totem grants 30% increased Area of Effect. Ancestral Warrior Totem grants 40% increased Glory Generation. Dark Effigy grants 40% increased Damage over Time. Spell Totem grants 50% increased Critical Hit Chance.

items.t: Support Gems can be inserted into sockets on a Skill Gem in order to modify the effects of that Skill.
items.d: Support Gems can be inserted into sockets on a Skill Gem in order to modify the effects of that Skill. They only apply to the Skill Gem they are socketed into. You cannot use multiple copies of the exact same Lineage Support across multiple Skills, or for Supports that grant global benefits to persistent reservation Skills while active. Cannot use multiple Support Gems of the same Category in one Skill.

items.t: One-handed weapons can be placed in the main weapon slot.
items.d: One-handed weapons can be placed in the main weapon slot. Some one-handed weapon types can be dual wielded in both main and off hand weapon slots.

items.t: You see what is and what might have been.
items.d: You see what is and what might have been. Reveal a suite of Oracle-only passive tree nodes after Ascending as an Oracle. On taking The Unseen Path Ascendancy Notable, gain the ability to allocate these nodes.

items.t: Stats that refer to an item's Energy Shield use the exact value listed on the item.
items.d: Stats that refer to an item's Energy Shield use the exact value listed on the item. This means that Quality and local modifiers on the item are taken into account, but stats from other sources that change the amount of Energy Shield actually granted to your character are not considered.

items.t: By default, chance-based stats cap at 100% chance for the result to occur.
items.d: By default, chance-based stats cap at 100% chance for the result to occur. However, some chances can exceed 100%. Unless otherwise specified, a chance higher than 100% is equivalent to 100% chance - the chance always succeeds. But some effects may scale based on how high the chance is or how much it exceeds 100% by.

items.t: You are on High Infernal Flame if you have 65% of your maximum Infernal Flame or more.
items.d: You are on High Infernal Flame if you have 65% of your maximum Infernal Flame or more.

items.t: Sands of Time grants 60% increased Skill Speed, scaling down to 1% over 10 seconds, at which point it will then scale back up to 60%.
items.d: Sands of Time grants 60% increased Skill Speed, scaling down to 1% over 10 seconds, at which point it will then scale back up to 60%. It also grants 1% increased Area of Effect, scaling up to 60% over 10 seconds, at which point it will then scale back down to 1%.

items.t: Debuffs you are Unaffected by can still be placed on you, but will not actually apply their effect.
items.d: Debuffs you are Unaffected by can still be placed on you, but will not actually apply their effect.

items.t: Modifiers to Ailment Application apply to: Bleeding, Poison and Shock chance Flammability, Freeze and Electrocution Buildup.
items.d: Modifiers to Ailment Application apply to: Bleeding, Poison and Shock chance Flammability, Freeze and Electrocution Buildup.

items.t: Basic Jewels do not affect nodes in a radius.
items.d: Basic Jewels do not affect nodes in a radius. Basic Jewels are Rubies, Emeralds, Sapphires and Diamonds.

items.t: Staves are Two-Handed Spellcasting weapons that require Intelligence to equip.
items.d: Staves are Two-Handed Spellcasting weapons that require Intelligence to equip. Staves cannot be used to Attack. However, they grant inbuilt Spells based on the staff type and powerful bonuses to spells.

items.t: Blue Flames of Chayula Leech 20% of your maximum Mana to you when collected.
items.d: Blue Flames of Chayula Leech 20% of your maximum Mana to you when collected.

items.t: Stats that refer to an item's Evasion use the exact value listed on the item.
items.d: Stats that refer to an item's Evasion use the exact value listed on the item. This means that Quality and local modifiers on the item are taken into account, but stats from other sources that change the amount of Evasion actually granted to your character are not considered.

items.t: Soaring Ground grants 30% increased Evasion Rating, 40% increased damage while on Full Life, and Onslaught to you or Allies standing on it.
items.d: Soaring Ground grants 30% increased Evasion Rating, 40% increased damage while on Full Life, and Onslaught to you or Allies standing on it. These effects Linger for 1 second. Soaring Ground has a 6 second base duration unless otherwise specified.

items.t: Protects the Bear Spirit's Allies while they are in its Presence, granting them 2% of maximum Life regenerated per second and causing 8% of the damage they would take to…
items.d: Protects the Bear Spirit's Allies while they are in its Presence, granting them 2% of maximum Life regenerated per second and causing 8% of the damage they would take to be taken by the Bear Spirit instead.

items.t: Enemies with Armour Broken below 0 have negative Armour.
items.d: Enemies with Armour Broken below 0 have negative Armour. This means they take more Physical damage from Hits. Armour broken below 0 is capped by the enemy's base Armour.

items.t: An item's Base Type refers to the specific variety of item it is, and grants it inherent properties such as damage on Martial Weapons, defensive bonuses on Armour, or Li…
items.d: An item's Base Type refers to the specific variety of item it is, and grants it inherent properties such as damage on Martial Weapons, defensive bonuses on Armour, or Life recovery on Life Flasks. It is also often responsible for the Level and/or Attribute Requirements to equip an item. For example: • Wrapped Quarterstaff and Long Quarterstaff are both Quarterstaff Base Types • Stocky Mitts and Linen Wraps are both Gloves Base Types • Lesser Mana Flask and Greater Mana Flask are both Mana Flask Base Types

items.t: A Possessed monster is a Rare or Unique monster that has had an Azmeri Spirit enter and empower them.
items.d: A Possessed monster is a Rare or Unique monster that has had an Azmeri Spirit enter and empower them. The possessed monster is empowered by the spirit and gains bonuses depending on the type of Spirit that possessed them. Occasionally the possessed monster will summon spiritual animals depending on the type of Animal Spirit they represent. Possessed monsters are more rewarding depending on how many Spirit-Influenced monsters were defeated leading up to possession.

items.t: Idols are a type of Augment fashioned by the Azmeri.
items.d: Idols are a type of Augment fashioned by the Azmeri.

items.t: Some modifiers on Runes and Idols are available only to players who have allocated the Shaman's Wisdom of the Maji Ascendancy Notable.
items.d: Some modifiers on Runes and Idols are available only to players who have allocated the Shaman's Wisdom of the Maji Ascendancy Notable.

items.t: You are on Low Energy Shield if you have 35% of your Maximum Energy Shield or less.
items.d: You are on Low Energy Shield if you have 35% of your Maximum Energy Shield or less.

items.t: Hits which could potentially be a Critical Hit but do not roll a Critical Hit will re-roll Critical Hit chance until they succeed.
items.d: Hits which could potentially be a Critical Hit but do not roll a Critical Hit will re-roll Critical Hit chance until they succeed. Hits have 30% less Critical Damage Bonus for each time Critical Hit chance was re-rolled.

items.t: Red Flames of Chayula Leech 20% of your maximum Life to you to when collected.
items.d: Red Flames of Chayula Leech 20% of your maximum Life to you to when collected.

items.t: While Thaumaturgical Dynamism is active, you passively generate a Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charge once every five seconds.
items.d: While Thaumaturgical Dynamism is active, you passively generate a Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charge once every five seconds. The kind of Charge you generate is determined by the Attribute Requirements of the Skills you have socketed in your Skill Gem sockets. The higher the total Strength Requirement total of your socketed Skill Gems, the more likely you will be to generate an Endurance Charge. Higher total Dexterity Requirement corresponds to a higher chance for Frenzy Charges, and Intelligence to Power Charges.

items.t: Two gems are considered Connected if one is socketed into the other, or if both are socketed into a third gem.
items.d: Two gems are considered Connected if one is socketed into the other, or if both are socketed into a third gem. A Support Gem socketed in a Meta Skill is still Connected to that Meta Skill and to all other Skills socketed in that Meta Skill, even if it cannot Support some of those skills.

items.t: Adaptations are gained by taking Elemental Damage from Hits and cause you to take less damage of that Type from subsequent Hits.
items.d: Adaptations are gained by taking Elemental Damage from Hits and cause you to take less damage of that Type from subsequent Hits. Unless otherwise specified, you can have 3 Adaptations at a time, and Adaptations do not have a duration.

items.t: Sceptres are One-Handed weapons that require Strength and Intelligence to equip.
items.d: Sceptres are One-Handed weapons that require Strength and Intelligence to equip. Sceptres can be equipped in your main hand or off hand, but you cannot Dual Wield two Sceptres. Sceptres cannot be used to Attack and do not grant bonuses to Spellcasting. Instead, they grant additional Spirit and can provide bonuses to your Allies.

items.t: Talismans are Two-Handed Melee weapons that require Strength and Intelligence to equip.
items.d: Talismans are Two-Handed Melee weapons that require Strength and Intelligence to equip. Talismans allow you to use Shapeshifting Skills associated with the Talisman's current form, and grants a basic Attack for that form. You can change the Talisman's form at any time. While you have a Talisman in your active weapon set you will Shapeshift into its associated form. As a result, Skills that cannot be used in a Shapeshift form cannot be used with Talismans. Triggered Skills and Persistent Skills will continue to function.

items.t: Depending on the type of Armour equipped, Players will have a less Movement Speed penalty applied depending on what Attribute the Armour requires.
items.d: Depending on the type of Armour equipped, Players will have a less Movement Speed penalty applied depending on what Attribute the Armour requires. These penalties only apply to equipped Body Armours and Shields. For Body Armour, pure Strength has a 5% penalty, hybrid Strength and Dexterity or Intelligence has a 4% penalty and pure Dexterity or Intelligence has a 3% penalty. For Shields, pure Strength has a 3% penalty, hybrid Strength and Dexterity or Intelligence has a 1.5% penalty and pure Dexterity or Intelligence has no penalty.
